hero.h1: SILLAGE 01 Encre — niche eau de parfum. The smell of a letter you never sent.
hero.concept: The smell of a letter you never sent.

beats.name: SILLAGE
beats.tagline: The trail a scent leaves behind.
beats.notesLead: Cold metal. Iris. Black tea. Wet ink.

story.body: Encre is built around the cold-metal smell of a fountain pen and the paper it never touched. Bergamot and pink pepper open sharp; iris and black tea settle into something unsaid; vetiver, papyrus and incense are the drawer you closed. An eau de parfum concentration, low and close to the skin — the sillage of a thought you kept to yourself.
story.perfumer: Composed by an independent perfumer in Grasse, 2026.
story.imageAlt: The Encre flacon resting on unsent letter paper

object.body: A heavy rectangular flacon in clear glass, 50 ml, matte-black cap, debossed mark. Filled and sealed by hand in small batches.

glass.title: The glass
glass.body: A rectangular block of clear glass, thick-walled, weighted to sit still on a desk.

cap.title: The cap
cap.body: Matte black, machined to a soft click. No spring, no atomiser rattle.

fill.title: The fill
fill.body: 50 ml, poured and left to settle by hand. Small batches, a few weeks apart.

batch.title: The batch
batch.body: Every flacon carries its batch number in debossed type on the base.

ritual.step1: Two sprays on warm skin — the inside of the wrist, the base of the throat.
ritual.step2: Do not rub. Let the top notes burn off on their own.
ritual.step3: Wear it in the evening, or when you want the room to ask.

newsletter.body: One letter a season. No more than that.
